dedupe_keys.name: localisation des zones de stationnement payant sur le littoral

description: Localisation des zones de stationnement payant sur le littoral is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Localisation des zones de stationnement payant (courte et longue durée) sur le littoral angloy. Afin de permettre une rotation des véhicules et d'éviter l'engorgement du littoral, la Ville a mis en place en 2023 une tarification du stationnement en journée pour les visiteurs. Le dispositif concernera l’ensemble des places du littoral, au nombre de 3000. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are stationnement, payant, littoral, parking, plage. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
